title: Batch run summary v1 (batch-run/1)
description: DRAFT for S1-01. One body for each run of a GCP batch job. The job sends it to POST /api/batch/runs after the publish step (S1-03). The trace ID is not in the body: it goes in the W3C traceparent HTTP header (S1-05). Field names of a record are the same as the contract v1.1 Trace record, so the shared judge code reads them without a change. See llm-metrics-standard.md. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in schema/README.md; the backend (S1-02) enforces them.

schema_version.description: Fixed value. The backend rejects any other version.

use_case_id.description: SOURCE: a constant in the job configuration. The ID of the use case in the YAML registry (S2-01). It must be the use case of the API key.

run_id.description: SOURCE (GCP answer 2026-10-08): <project name>-<UTC start time of the execution>, for example rtr-fraud-validation-20261008T093000Z. The job makes it one time at the start of the execution. A retry of the send uses the same ID. A new execution, also for the same business date, is a new run with a new ID. For a Batch API job, the run is the execution that gets the results and publishes them.

status.description: SOURCE (GCP answer 2026-10-08): 'completed': the job published, and failed_count is 0. 'partial': the job published, and failed_count is more than 0 (the failed rows show their error to the users). 'failed': the job did not publish, because the job code caught an error before or during the publish step.

completed_at.description: SOURCE: the job clock in UTC, taken immediately after the publish step ends (for example after FraudValidationPipeline._publish() in rtr-fraud-validation), or when the job code catches the failure. UTC, ISO 8601, with 'Z'.

submitted_at.description: OPTIONAL. SOURCE: the time when the job submitted the batch to Gemini (for the Batch API: when the batch job was created). UTC, ISO 8601, with 'Z'. Not later than completed_at. The monitor calculates turnaround_s = completed_at - submitted_at. Omit the field if the job does not know the time; never send null.

request_count.description: SOURCE (GCP answer 2026-10-08): the number of ALL Gemini requests in the run, successful and failed. Each request is counted one time, also if the job retries it. An input row that makes no request (for example no photo) is not counted. Example: 137 successful and 106 failed gives request_count 243 and failed_count 106. If the job fails before the first request, request_count is 0.

failed_count.description: SOURCE (GCP answer 2026-10-08): the number of requests with no usable output: an API error, an empty response, an output that does not parse or does not agree with the output schema, an error row or a failed job from the Gemini Batch API, or a system error. A part of request_count, so never more than request_count. A safety block is not a failure: it is a record with refused=true.

model.description: SOURCE: the Gemini model ID that the job called, for example 'gemini-2.5-flash'. If the job calls more than one model, the model of the main generation step.

sample.description: How the job selected the records.

method.description: Only uniform random sampling in v1.

size.description: SOURCE: the job setting SAMPLE_SIZE (default 50). The configured sample size, not the number of records sent. The backend compares it with the registry (8 to 200).

records.description: The sampled records, with PII replaced by placeholders. Sample only from the requests that Gemini answered or refused; never include a failed request. Empty in identity-only mode (SEND_RECORDS off), when the job failed, or when request_count is 0.

records_reason.description: Why records is empty. Required when records is empty and request_count is more than 0. Not allowed when records has items. 'records_not_approved': identity-only mode. 'job_failed': status is 'failed' (PROPOSED, not yet in the standard).

allOf.description: A run with no requests has no records.
Empty records with requests: a reason is required.
A failed run sends no records, and its reason is job_failed. Other runs never use job_failed.

redactedText.description: Free text. Phone numbers, email addresses and national ID numbers are replaced by [PHONE], [EMAIL] and [NATIONAL_ID] before the send (S1-03).

record_id.description: SOURCE (GCP answer 2026-10-08): the row number of the input, for example req-000047 for row 47. Unique in the run. It is not a request counter: rows that make no request leave gaps, so an ID can be larger than request_count. Never a customer ID, account number or phone number.

question.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in (which part of the prompt). The instruction that the model got, without the source material and without the system prompt. Redacted. If the prompt contains an image, write the marker [IMAGE] where each image was; never send the image, base64 data or an image URL.

answer.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The output text of the model for this request. Redacted. Can be empty only when refused is true (blocked, no output).

retrieval_context.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in (which part of the prompt). The source material that the model got with the instruction: any input text that the answer must agree with, for example a document, a transaction, a complaint, OCR text or retrieved chunks. Not only for document retrieval. Send the text as the model got it, one item for each source. [] if the prompt has no text source material, for example when the only input is an image.

doc_id.description: An ID of the source document. Never a customer ID.

title.description: A short title of the source document. Can be empty. Redacted.

text.description: The text of the source document as the model got it. Redacted.

tool_calls.description: Optional. Only if the job uses Gemini function calls. The judge treats each output as source material.

output.description: The function result that the model got. Any JSON value. Redacted.

refused.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. true if the model declined or was blocked: finishReason SAFETY / PROHIBITED_CONTENT / BLOCKLIST / SPII, promptFeedback.blockReason set, or a clear refusal text.

latency_s.description: SOURCE: the time of the Gemini call in seconds, measured by the job. null for the Gemini Batch API (no time for each request). Never 0.
